dogecoin.text: - NYSE Arca has filed with the SEC to list Grayscale’s spot Dogecoin ETF, kicking off a regulatory review that could take up to 90 days, as Grayscale expands its crypto ETF offerings.

- Neptune Digital Assets Corp purchased 1M DOGE tokens for $270K in late 2024 becoming the second publicly traded company to acquire 
Dogecoin, according to VanEck Head of Digital Assets Research Matt Sigel with plans to expand its crypto holdings while managing leverage risk.
- Dogecoin, XRP and Cardano Down 26% as Bitcoin Sinks Again.
Bitcoin Drops Below $95K as Solana, XRP and Dogecoin Keep Falling.
